column1: # Expected per-cell ploidy for BioProject PRJNA629885 (ACT single-cell WGS).
# Source: Minussi DC, Nicholson MD, Ye H, et al. "Breast tumours maintain a reservoir of
# The published legend defines that column as the FACS mean ploidy of the aneuploid cell
# population (DAPI staining). That is exactly the experimental point estimate scAbsolute
# (Genome Biol 2024;25:62) uses as ground truth for this ACT dataset, so `ploidy` below is
# the p_exp fed to ploidy_eval.py. Values are per sample, not per cell: real cell-to-cell
# ploidy variation exists within each sample and is part of what the +/-0.5 window absorbs.
#   sample             canonical sample id (used in all output tables)
#   ploidy             expected ploidy = mean absolute copy number (scAbsolute Eq. 1 scale)
#   aliases            '|'-separated alternative spellings; 're:<regex>' is matched as a regex
#   n_cells_published  number of single cells sequenced, per Table S1 (sanity check only)
#   source             provenance of the ploidy value
# NOTE ON NAME MATCHING: the ACT run titles in SRA are of the form <sample>_S<sector>_C<cell>
# (e.g. TN2_S6_C359), which ploidy_eval.py collapses to the sample id by token-prefix backoff.
# The TN1-TN8 ids are confirmed against the SRA titles for this BioProject. The cell-line
# aliases below are written generously because the exact cell-line spelling used in the run
# table was not verified; check them against your SraRunTable and extend the `aliases` column
# if any cell-line cells show up as unresolved.
